llm.summary: This skill is internally consistent with a Google Workspace CLI: it requires the gog binary (installable via a brew tap), instructs a normal OAuth client setup and use of the CLI, and does not request unrelated credentials or unusual installs.

dimensions.detail: The skill's documented behavior (gog / gogcli Google Workspace CLI) matches the install requirement (brew formula steipete/tap/gogcli -> provides gog). One small packaging inconsistency: the top-level registry name/slug is 'Tmp' while the SKILL.md and included files name the tool 'gog'/'gogcli' — likely sloppy metadata but does not change functionality.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructions are narrowly scoped to installing/authorizing and using the gog CLI (OAuth client creation, running gog auth add, and example gmail/calendar/drive/sheets/docs commands). It does not instruct reading unrelated files or exfiltrating data to unexpected endpoints. It does note that credentials and tokens are stored under ~/.config/gog/, which is expected for a CLI that persists OAuth tokens.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Install is via a Homebrew formula (steipete/tap/gogcli) which is a low-risk, conventional mechanism. There are no ad-hoc downloads or obscure URLs in the install spec. As usual, verify you trust the brew tap/maintainer before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not declare or require environment variables or unrelated credentials. It asks users to create Google OAuth client credentials (desktop app) and provide the client_secret.json to perform OAuth — this is appropriate for a Google API client. It also suggests an optional GOG_ACCOUNT env var to simplify repeated commands.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No elevated persistence requested (always:false). The skill does imply local storage of OAuth tokens under the CLI config (~/.config/gog/), which is normal for this type of tool and is limited to the tool's own config area.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This appears to be a legitimate Google Workspace CLI. Before installing: (1) verify the Homebrew tap (steipete/tap) and the upstream project (e.g., GitHub) are trustworthy; review the formula if you can. (2) Understand you'll create OAuth client credentials in Google Cloud and provide a client_secret.json; the resulting tokens will be stored locally under ~/.config/gog/ — treat those as sensitive and revoke them if you uninstall. (3) When authorizing, pay attention to the scopes you grant (gmail send/read, drive, sheets, etc.) and only grant what you need. (4) The packaging metadata uses the inconsistent name 'Tmp' vs 'gog/gogcli' — this looks like a labeling mistake; prefer confirming source integrity if you require higher assurance. If you need stronger guarantees, inspect the gogcli source or the brew formula before installing.
